comment: Synthetic tool output for #508. %R% becomes a random lowercase-and-digit run each test, so no literal here looks like a credential. `masked` is the stdout agent-guard returns (null: left untouched) and applies to both hosts: Claude rewrites updatedToolOutput, Codex blocks and carries the same text in additionalContext. `prompt` is the UserPromptSubmit exit code for the same text on both hosts.
